name: Nightmare Bauble
text: Limit 1 per deck. Forced - After Nightmare Bauble enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Dream Parasite and attach them to Nightmare Bauble. When Nightmare Bauble leaves play, set each attached Dream Parasite aside, out of play. [reaction] When you reveal an [auto_fail] chaos token, shuffle an attached Dream Parasite into your deck: Cancel that token.
text_cn: 每副牌组限制1张。 强制 - 在噩梦球入场后：在你的绑定卡牌中查找3张梦境寄生物，并将其叠加到噩梦球。在噩梦球离场时，将叠加的每张梦境寄生物放在一边，位于场外。 [reaction] 在你抽出一个[auto_fail]混乱标记时，将一张叠加的梦境寄生物混洗入你的牌堆：取消该标记。
